subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Shared runtime scaffolding: device-backed texture/resource creation and value getters, high-resolution timing (QPC/RDTSC), audio-channel timer access, scene-node sibling traversal, sub-resource flag clearing, flag-guarded init dispatch, generic linked lists, resource-registry facades, and buffered line/token parsers.

summary: DERIVED proposal for 28 generic runtime objects. The strongest groupings are (a) a HighResolutionTimer with a 64-bit timestamp/accumulator layout and QPC/RDTSC mode flag, plus a channel-index accessor over a global channel array; (b) a device-backed resource object that dispatches texture creation and getters through a graphics-device pointer stored at this+0x1100; (c) a texture surface pool using a global buffer-lock manager; (d) generic singly linked lists sharing a node next-pointer at +0x1C; (e) a resource-registry facade over global 0x008B8F2C; and (f) buffered line/token parsers sharing an input-string / working-buffer / token-pointer layout (this+0xC / +0x18C / +0x30C). Owners are UNKNOWN for all functions; classes are conservative groupings with DERIVED fields and GUESS names. Several odd artifacts (global 0xFF00000000005406, global 0x0059E430, unaccessed field 0x10 and 0x3C0/0x3D0/0x3D8) are carried in unresolved rather than laundered into structure.

function_roles.role: Texture-resource creation: resolves the resource descriptor at *(a2+84), dispatches begin-creation (device vtable +0x48) and final creation (device vtable +0x50) through the device at this+0x1100, maps compressed-format enum values 9..0xD to opaque format constants via jump table 0x00554F6C (uncompressed path delegates to 0x0055C650), sets ready flag 0x8 on *(v3+24), and returns -2/-1/0 by stage.
Unconditional getter wrapper: loads the device pointer at this+0x1100, calls its vtable method at +0x88 (stdcall, device pointer as arg), caches the returned integer at this+0x0, and returns it.

Unconditional getter dispatch: calls vtable method at byte offset 0x8C on the sub-object at this+0x1100 (sub-object pointer as arg), caches the result at this+0x0, and returns it; shared by sub_553070, sub_553700 and sub_557120.
Shared prefix zero-initializer: calls GlobalZeroInit_c2a0(this) then explicitly zeroes seventeen DWORD fields (0x0 and 0x8 through 0x44); returns this.

High-resolution timer reset: samples a fresh timestamp (QueryPerformanceCounter when mode bit 0 at this+0x48 is set, else RDTSC via 0x0055687B), stores it at 0x18/0x1C, snapshots to 0x20/0x24, clears accumulators 0x10/0x14, 0x28/0x2C and previous timestamps 0x30/0x34, and returns the frequency word at this+0x0; body runs only when the timer is initialized.

Timer elapsed-time query: computes the delta of a fresh timestamp (via 0x005564B0) against the snapshot at this+0x20/0x24, stores the new timestamp back, and converts ticks to seconds using the frequency word at this+0x0 and the reciprocal scaling factor at this+0x8.

Adjusted elapsed-time query: samples a fresh timestamp (via 0x005564B0), subtracts the reference timestamp at this+0x18/0x1C and the accumulated delta at this+0x28/0x2C, and converts to seconds with a fixed-point divisor built from the frequency word at this+0x0 plus the 0x4 factor and the 0x8 base term; read-only.

Reference-delta query: samples a fresh timestamp (via 0x005564B0), subtracts the reference timestamp at this+0x18/0x1C, and converts the tick delta to seconds using the frequency word at this+0x0 and the reciprocal scaling factor at this+0x8; read-only.

Bounds-checked per-channel timer query: validates index a1 against the global channel count 0x008B8E48 (returns 0.0 out of range), indexes the per-channel entry &dword_8B6C28[19*a1+608] (19-DWORD stride, 608-DWORD base), and returns GetElapsedTimeSeconds (0x00556510) on that entry.

Fixed 512-iteration constructor walk: seeds the pointer at global table 0x008CBF70, advances 6 dwords (24 bytes) per entry, calls ShortComputation_8e00 (0x00548E00) on each entry, and returns the last call's result.

Recursive scene-node traversal over the sibling chain: reads the node mask at this+0x38 and breaks when the masked global render-visibility mask (0x008B8E34 combined with the caller mask at a2+0x84) does not cover it; dispatches animation updates via 0x00556980, recurses into children when this+0x44 is set, and follows the next-sibling pointer at this+0x4C until null or the sibling continuation flag at this+0x40 is zero.

Clears a per-element flag dword at byte offset 520 (element stride 132 dwords) of each of four sub-resource arrays, each driven by its own count/pointer pair (0x1B4/0x1B8, 0x1C4/0x1C8, 0x1BC/0x1C0, 0x1CC/0x1D0); render/scene cleanup helper.

Constructor/initializer writing literal defaults: zero byte at this+0x0, zero dwords at this+0x20/0x24, three 1.0f floats (0x28/0x2C/0x30), a 100.0f float (0x34), zero dwords at 0x58/0x5C, 0xFFFFFF at 0x60, 65538 at 0x64, 0 at 0x68, 3 at 0x6C, zero bytes at 0x70 and 0x90; returns this.
Flag-based dispatcher: tests bit 0x8 at a2+32; set -> call sub_557670(a2), clear -> call sub_557CE0(this, a2); a non-zero callee return yields -1, else 0.

Init-once dispatcher on the flags dword at this+0x20: returns 0 immediately when bit 0x400 is set (already initialized); otherwise bit 0x8 selects Return0Stub (0x0047ABB0) or sub_558310(this); non-zero callee return yields -1, and on success bit 0x400 is OR-ed into the flags and 0 returned.

Lazy texture-buffer allocation: skips when bit 0x100 is already set at this+0x20 (guarded path returns the stored flags), sets bit 0x100, indexes the descriptor table at this[20] (this+0x50) by slot a2<<6 (64-byte stride), selects a 96-byte or 32-byte entry size from flag bit 0x80, allocates through BufferLockAllocate (0x00540F00) on the buffer-lock manager global 0x008B78A0, and stores the returned handle at descriptor+32.

Texture-surface release: when bit 0x100 is set at this+0x20, clears that bit, releases the surface's audio resource via ArithmeticComparison_0f90 (0x00540F90) on the buffer-lock manager global 0x008B78A0 using the descriptor at this+0x50 (64-byte stride) selected by index a2<<6 plus 0x1C, and zeroes descriptor+0x20; otherwise does nothing.

Search-or-append in a pair-keyed singly linked list: walks the chain rooted at this+0x8 matching node keys +0x14/+0x18 against (a2,a3); on a miss allocates a 32-byte node via 0x00587C03, zero-initializes via 0x00559330, links it at the tail (or head when the list was empty), and sets the keys via StructFieldInit_9390 (0x00559390).

Linear string search over a singly linked list rooted at this+0x0: compares each node-start string against target a2 via strcmp and returns the first matching node, or 0 when the list is empty or the next pointer (node+0x1C) goes null.

Linear string search over a singly linked list rooted at this+0x4: compares each node-start string against key a2 via strcmp, advances through the next pointer at node+0x1C, and returns the matching node or 0 on empty/exhausted lists.

Resource-lookup facade over the global registry object 0x008B8F2C: when non-null, delegates (a1,a2,a3) to sub_5594B0 on that object and returns its result; when null, logs the 'Could not find re...' literal 0x005DC1D8 via sub_53C590 and returns -1.

Stdcall dispatcher over the global registry object 0x008B8F2C: when non-null, forwards all three arguments to sub_559570 with the global as the leading this-like argument and returns its result; when null, logs the 'Could not find re...' literal 0x005DC1D8 via sub_53C590 with code -1 and returns -1.
Large-buffer initializer: memsets a 0x180-byte body span starting at this+0xC, zeroes the leading fields at this+0x0/0x4/0x8 and the trailing fields at this+0x30C/0x310, and returns this.

Line reader: copies bytes from the data buffer at this+0x310 (position this+0x4) into the line buffer at this+0xC until a newline (10) or buffer size this+0x8, sets reader status this+0x0 to 3 on buffer exhaustion, null-terminates the line, and post-processes via sub_559AD0 when the line is non-empty and status is not 3.

Prefix tokenizer lookup: copies the string at this+0xC into the working buffer at this+0x18C, tokenizes with the delimiter 0x005C30AC, returns FALSE when no token exists or the token equals key a2 (per 0x00588410); otherwise runs a second tokenizer pass with 0x005EA438 and returns TRUE only on a non-null token; token tracked at this+0x30C.

Chain tokenizer lookup: copies the string at this+0xC into the working buffer at this+0x18C, then steps past '.HOT' delimited candidates (delimiter 0x005C32D8, tokens split by 0x005C30AC) seeking the first token not equal to key a2, tracking the current token at this+0x30C; returns FALSE on exhaustion.

Parse up to four integers: gates on the sub_559D80 lookup (0 on failure), seeds the parse position from the token pointer at this+0x30C plus one, parses up to four integers via CallWrapperWith0 (0x00589278) into each non-null optional output pointer, and returns the lookup success flag.

Generate up to four uniform floats: gates on the sub_559D80 seeding/validation call (0 on failure), reads and increments the seed at this+0x30C, and for each non-null output pointer draws a uniform float via sub_58B077 (0x0058B077) with an advancing seed state; returns 1 when generation ran.

classes.name: GraphicsDeviceBackedResource
classes.responsibility: Resource object that holds a graphics-device sub-object pointer at this+0x1100 and performs texture-resource creation plus cached value getters through that device's vtable.

classes.name: HighResolutionTimer
classes.responsibility: High-resolution timer object: samples timestamps from QPC or RDTSC (mode flag at 0x48), keeps a reference timestamp, snapshot, and accumulators as 64-bit word pairs, and converts tick deltas to seconds using a frequency word and reciprocal scaling factor.

classes.name: AudioChannelTimerIndex
classes.responsibility: Static, bounds-checked accessor over a global per-channel array; returns the embedded high-resolution timer's elapsed seconds for a valid channel index.

classes.name: FixedTableInitializer
classes.responsibility: Runs a fixed 512-iteration constructor/init pass over a global 512-entry, 24-byte-stride table.

classes.name: SceneNodeTree
classes.responsibility: Scene node traversal over a sibling-linked node chain with visibility-mask gating, per-node animation dispatch, and child recursion.

classes.name: SubResourceArrayOwner
classes.responsibility: Owner of four parallel sub-resource arrays described by count/pointer pairs; clears a per-element flag dword at byte offset 520 in each array.

classes.name: DefaultsObject
classes.responsibility: Object whose initializer writes literal defaults including a 1.0f float triple, a 100.0f float, a white color, a packed flag word, and a count/category.

classes.name: FlagGuardedDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Guard-then-dispatch wrappers that select among guarded init/update subroutines based on flag bits, propagate callee failure as -1, and set init-done flags.

classes.name: TextureSurfacePool
classes.responsibility: Lazily allocates and releases texture-surface buffers through a global buffer-lock manager, tracking allocation state in a flags dword and per-surface handles in a 64-byte-stride descriptor table.

classes.name: PairKeyedLinkedList
classes.responsibility: Singly linked list keyed by an integer pair; searches nodes by matching keys and appends a newly allocated 32-byte node on a miss.

classes.name: StringKeyedLinkedList
classes.responsibility: Singly linked list searched linearly by strcmp against the node-start string; nodes carry the next pointer at +0x1C and the two search methods read their list head from different holder offsets (0x0 and 0x4).

classes.name: ResourceRegistryFacade
classes.responsibility: Static facade over a global resource-registry object (0x008B8F2C); delegates lookups through a forward handler or reports the missing-object message and returns -1.

classes.name: BufferedTextLineReader
classes.responsibility: Buffered reader that zero-initializes a large object, then reads one line at a time from an in-object data buffer into a line buffer, tracking position, buffer size, and a reader status field.

classes.name: TokenLookupParser
classes.responsibility: Scene/token parser utilities: copies an input string to a working buffer, tokenizes with chain/prefix delimiters, and parses up to four integers or generates up to four uniform floats from the resulting token state.

classes.name: GenericZeroInitBase
classes.responsibility: Base zero-initializer that invokes a shared global zero-init helper and then zeroes seventeen DWORD prefix fields (0x0, 0x8 through 0x44).

transitions.trigger: position reaches buffer size; reader status at this+0x0 is set to 3
lazy allocation sets bit 0x100 in the flags dword at this+0x20
surface release clears bit 0x100 in the flags dword at this+0x20

interfaces.name: GraphicsDeviceInterface
interfaces.purpose: Device object reachable from resource objects at this+0x1100. Exposes vtable methods for begin-creation (slot +0x48), final creation (slot +0x50), and value getters (slots +0x88, +0x8C). Exact method addresses unresolved.

interfaces.name: BufferLockManager
interfaces.purpose: Global buffer-lock manager (0x008B78A0) providing allocation (0x00540F00) and release (0x00540F90) used by the texture surface pool; the exact resource semantics are unconfirmed.

compatibility_contracts.name: HighResolutionTimerLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must preserve the timer object layout: frequency word at this+0x0, reciprocal scale at this+0x8, accumulators at +0x10/+0x14, current timestamp +0x18/+0x1C, snapshot +0x20/+0x24, delta accumulator +0x28/+0x2C, previous timestamps +0x30/+0x34, and mode flag at +0x48 where bit 0 selects QueryPerformanceCounter vs RDTSC as the timestamp source.

compatibility_contracts.name: DeviceBackedResourceDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: Resource objects must keep the graphics-device pointer at this+0x1100 and route creation/getters through that device's vtable slots +0x48 (begin creation), +0x50 (final creation), +0x88 and +0x8C (getters); results are cached at this+0x0. Slot targets are unresolved.

compatibility_contracts.name: CompressedFormatConstantTable
compatibility_contracts.description: Format enum values 9..0xD map through the jump table at 0x00554F6C to the constants 827611204, 844388420, 861165636, 877942852 and 894720068 (interpreted in prior analysis as DXT FourCC codes; that mapping is not proven by this packet).

compatibility_contracts.name: StringListSearchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: String-keyed linked-list nodes store the compared string at the node address and the next pointer at node+0x1C; searches compare via strcmp and return the first matching node or 0 when the list is empty or exhausted.

compatibility_contracts.name: TextureSurfacePoolContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The surface pool tracks allocation state in bit 0x100 of the flags dword at this+0x20 and manages per-surface descriptors (64-byte stride) under this+0x50; allocation and release go through the global buffer-lock manager 0x008B78A0 (allocate 0x00540F00, release 0x00540F90).

compatibility_contracts.name: ResourceRegistryGlobalContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The global registry object at 0x008B8F2C backs resource lookups; when it is null, the lookup facades log the 'Could not find re...' message literal 0x005DC1D8 via 0x0053C590 and return -1.

unresolved: The two graphics-device virtual-dispatch targets (vtable +0x48 begin-create and +0x50 final-create) and the getter slots +0x88/+0x8C are opaque interface methods; their concrete targets are unresolved.

The 827611204/844388420/861165636/877942852/894720068 constants are interpreted in prior analysis as DXT FourCC codes, but that mapping is not proven by the packet and they are treated here as opaque format constants.

Global 0xFF00000000005406 is listed by packet facts but does not appear in the raw decompilation of HighResolutionTimerReset; it is likely a mis-extracted constant associated with the RDTSC path and is left unresolved.
Global 0x0059E430 (dbl_59E430) is listed as read by AudioChannelGetTimerElapsed but does not appear in the raw source text; its role is not established.
TimerQueryAdjustedElapsedTime reads an unlisted field at this+0x4 (factor) and uses a fixed-point divisor whose exact semantics are inferred rather than documented.
HighResolutionTimer field 0x10 is listed by packet facts as read-only but never referenced in the decompiled bodies that use other timer fields; its role is unconfirmed.
Caller sub_554F80 (0x00554F80) of the texture-resource creation routine is not analyzed in this packet.
The forward handlers sub_5594B0 and sub_559570 are called in raw source but absent from the packet callee lists; their semantics are unknown.
PairKeyedLinkedList allocation-path return values are Hex-Rays artifacts reading never-initialized registers; only the search-hit path return is well-defined.
StringKeyedLinkedList reads its list head from this+0x0 in one search and this+0x4 in the other; the two may be distinct holder layouts, so grouping the two functions is provisional.

Global dword_8B78A0 is carried from prior analysis with the name 'SoundManager' but with no packet evidence; it is treated here only as the buffer-lock manager pointer used by the texture surface pool.
SceneNodeTree recursion passes a2 rather than a child pointer; the callee's own 'this' must be derived elsewhere.

InitializeDefaults writes no vtable pointer, so it cannot be determined whether it is a complete constructor or a partial field reset on an already-vtabled object; its callers (named in the packet as MaterialShaderReactionEffectParser and UIListNodeManager) are not in the allowed evidence set.

TokenLookupParser groups a seeded-float generator (0x00559FB0) with tokenizer/parser utilities on the strength of the shared this+0xC/0x18C/0x30C field layout and the common sub_559D80 gating call; the PRNG semantics are not resolved.

The channel-count (0x008B8E48) and channel-array (0x008B6C28, 19-DWORD stride, 608-DWORD base) interpretation of AudioChannelTimerIndex is DERIVED from prior analysis and is not independently evidenced.
LineReaderStatus states other than the exhausted value 3 are unknown; the status field's full enumeration is not evidenced.
The line buffer capacity at this+0xC in BufferedTextLineReader is not a tracked field; its bound is unknown.
ClearSubResourceFlags lists fields this+0x3C0, this+0x3D0 and this+0x3D8 in packet facts, but none is accessed in the function body; their roles are unconfirmed.
